xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4714: Clicking an issue link in a conversation should open the issue's pop-out drawer, not a new browser tab

plan.title: Clicking an issue link in a conversation should open the issue's pop-out drawer, not a new browser tab
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Conversation transcripts render issue references as tracker links (e.g. [PAN-4645](https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/issues/4645)). TranscriptLink renders every link as <a target=_blank>, so a click opens GitHub in a new tab and the operator loses their place in the conversation.
narratives.Proposal: Add a pure tracker-issue URL parser and resolver to @overdeck/contracts (parseTrackerIssueUrl / resolveTrackerIssueId) beside parsePullRequestRef. Expose each project's tracker type on GET /api/registered-projects via the existing tryResolveProjectTrackerType. Inside a conversation (ConversationPullRequestContext present), TranscriptLink delegates non-PR tracker issue URLs to a new TranscriptIssueLink that resolves the issue ID against the cached ['registered-projects'] query; a plain left click calls openIssue(id, 'overview') and prevents navigation, while modified clicks, middle-click and the context menu keep the new-tab default. Unresolvable links, PR links and links outside a conversation are unchanged. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4714.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Issue links outside a conversation transcript (PrdViewer, PlanApprovalDialog, SessionPanel raw ChatMarkdown, AgentSection, ReviewSummary, DiscussionsTab, MarkdownTab, MessagesTimeline hosts that bypass ConversationPanel) must keep opening a new tab.
- No GitLab, Rally, GitHub Enterprise or www.github.com issue URL support.
- No issue_prefixes (multi-prefix) resolution; only issue_prefix.
- Bare issue IDs in plain text must not become links.
- No hardcoded prefix-to-repo table may be added (do not extend GITHUB_REPO_BY_PREFIX in lib/issueLinks.ts).
- Do not fix the stale KRUX entry in lib/issueLinks.ts in this issue.
- Do not refactor the existing inline ['registered-projects'] useQuery calls into a shared hook.
- Do not change PR/MR link behaviour (PAN-3822 menu and new-tab click).
- Do not edit the OKF knowledge bundle (separate repo).

autoDecisions.summary: Drawer-open behaviour applies only inside conversation transcripts (ConversationPullRequestContext present).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue scopes the change to conversations, and ChatMarkdown also renders in PrdViewer (z-110) and PlanApprovalDialog (z-100) where a drawer (z-100) would open hidden behind the modal.

autoDecisions.summary: Parser and resolver live in @overdeck/contracts (packages/contracts/src/tracker-issue-ref.ts) beside parsePullRequestRef.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors PAN-3822's placement, stays pure and unit-testable, and avoids importing src/lib/issue-id.ts (contains require('node:fs')) into the browser.

autoDecisions.summary: Add a tracker field to GET /api/registered-projects using tryResolveProjectTrackerType; GitHub URLs map only for tracker === 'github' projects, Linear URLs only for tracker === 'linear' projects with the matching prefix.
autoDecisions.rationale: lexerra has tracker: linear plus github_repo; without the tracker type a GitHub issue URL would map to the wrong LEX-<n> issue. Reusing the existing resolver avoids a new rule table.

autoDecisions.summary: Projects without issue_prefix do not resolve; their links keep the new-tab behaviour.
autoDecisions.rationale: linearTeam is null for them (papers-please, orca) and there is no reliable issue ID to open.

autoDecisions.summary: Only a plain left click (button 0, no Ctrl/Meta/Shift/Alt, not defaultPrevented) is intercepted; href/target/rel stay on the anchor.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps Ctrl/Cmd-click, Shift-click, middle-click (auxclick) and the context menu as browser defaults, as the issue requires.

autoDecisions.summary: A click on the open drawer's own issue switches it to the overview tab; no special case.
autoDecisions.rationale: Follows directly from openIssue(id, 'overview'), matches the issue's AC literally, and keeps the code simple.

autoDecisions.summary: The Playwright check is a UAT checkpoint with a PR screenshot, not a committed e2e spec.
autoDecisions.rationale: The existing e2e harness needs ~200 lines of Vite and WS mocks to show a conversation; the issue asks only for a Playwright check with a screenshot in the PR.

autoDecisions.summary: Also add the existing ChatMarkdown.pull-request-links.test.tsx to the CI frontend test subset.
autoDecisions.rationale: The TranscriptLink change can regress PAN-3822 behaviour, and that test is not in the subset today.

items.title: Add parseTrackerIssueUrl and resolveTrackerIssueId to @overdeck/contracts

verify_commands: cd packages/contracts && npx vitest run --configLoader runner --config vitest.config.ts src/__tests__/tracker-issue-ref.test.ts

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. Create packages/contracts/src/tracker-issue-ref.ts exporting TrackerIssueUrlRef, TrackerIssueProject, parseTrackerIssueUrl(input) and resolveTrackerIssueId(ref, projects) with the code given in the PRD. GitHub URLs must have host github.com and path <owner>/<repo>/issues/<n> (n > 0, safe integer; tails like /, ?x and #issuecomment-1 allowed); repository is lower-cased. Linear URLs are linear.app/<ws>/issue/<KEY-n>[/slug]; identifier is upper-cased. resolveTrackerIssueId returns <PREFIX>-<n> for the first project with tracker === 'github', a non-empty linearTeam and githubRepo equal (case-insensitive) to the repository; for Linear it returns the identifier when a project with tracker === 'linear' has linearTeam equal to the identifier's prefix; otherwise null. It must tolerate null/junk rows. Export the module from packages/contracts/src/index.ts right after the pull-request-ref export. Write the 7 named test cases listed in the PRD.

items.title: Given https://github.com/Eltmon/Overdeck/issues/4645 and the same URL with #issuecomment-9, parseTrackerIssueUrl returns { tracker: 'github', repository: 'eltmon/overdeck', number: 4645 }; given https://linear.app/mindyournow/issue/min-663/some-title it returns { tracker: 'linear', identifier: 'MIN-663' }
parseTrackerIssueUrl returns null for a /pull/42 URL, a bare /issues list, /issues/new, /issues/0 and https://gitlab.com/a/b/-/issues/3

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-3 exactly. Create components/chat/TranscriptIssueLink.tsx (code in the PRD): it reads the shared ['registered-projects'] query (staleTime 60_000, throws on !res.ok), treats non-array data as no projects, resolves the issue ID with resolveTrackerIssueId, renders <a href target=_blank rel='noopener noreferrer' className data-issue-id={issueId}> and, on a plain click only (button 0, no ctrl/meta/shift/alt, not defaultPrevented, issueId resolved), calls preventDefault() then openIssue(issueId, 'overview'). In TranscriptPullRequestLink.tsx, make TranscriptLink compute issueRef = context && href && !prRef ? parseTrackerIssueUrl(href) : null and return <TranscriptIssueLink> when issueRef is set; leave the PR path unchanged; update the file header comment to describe both behaviours (PAN-4714). In ChatMarkdown.tsx change only the comment on line 413 to mention PAN-4714. Write components/chat/__tests__/ChatMarkdown.issue-links.test.tsx with the 5 named cases in the PRD (stub fetch for /api/registered-projects, replace openIssue via useDashboardStore.setState and restore it in afterEach, stub window.open with vi.spyOn(window, 'open').mockReturnValue(null) and restore it in afterEach (happy-dom's anchor dispatchEvent calls window.open(href, target, features) for every click that is not default-prevented, so that call is the evidence of default navigation), waitFor data-issue-id before clicking). Add ChatMarkdown.issue-links.test.tsx and ChatMarkdown.pull-request-links.test.tsx to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt in sorted position. Fallback: if vi.spyOn(window, 'open') does not intercept happy-dom's internal window.open call, keep the fireEvent.click return-value and openIssue assertions and drop only the window.open expectation.

items.title: Given [PAN-4645](https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/issues/4645) rendered by ChatMarkdown inside ConversationPullRequestProvider with registered projects loaded, a plain fireEvent.click returns false, calls openIssue once with ('PAN-4645', 'overview'), and window.open is not called

When the same link is Ctrl-clicked or Cmd-clicked, fireEvent.click returns true, openIssue is not called, and the stubbed window.open receives the tracker URL and '_blank' (happy-dom's default anchor navigation)

Given an issue URL for an unregistered repo, a GitHub issue URL for a linear-tracked project, or the PAN-4645 link rendered outside a conversation, the anchor has no data-issue-id attribute, fireEvent.click returns true, the stubbed window.open receives that URL and '_blank', and openIssue is not called

A PR URL (https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/42) inside a conversation still renders the 'Link to conversation' context menu on right-click and returns true from a plain fireEvent.click without calling openIssue; the existing ChatMarkdown.pull-request-links.test.tsx passes unchanged

scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt lists ChatMarkdown.issue-links.test.tsx and ChatMarkdown.pull-request-links.test.tsx in sorted position, and node scripts/run-frontend-test-subset.mjs --dry-run prints both paths

narrative.Action: Implementation checkpoint, PRD WI-4. Build contracts (cd packages/contracts && npm run build), start the workspace frontend in the background with `cd src/dashboard/frontend && npx vite --port 3110 --strictPort` (proxies /api and /ws to the live dashboard at 127.0.0.1:3011). In a fresh, isolated Playwright browser (chromium.launch + newContext; never a shared profile or another agent's session), if /api/registered-projects lacks a tracker field, intercept it with page.route and add tracker per row ('github' when githubRepo, else 'linear' when linearTeam). Open a /conv/<id> whose transcript contains a https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/issues/<n> link, click a[data-issue-id], assert [data-testid=issue-drawer] is visible with that issue ID in its header, save .tmp/pan-4714-issue-drawer.png (gitignored), and attach the screenshot plus the commands used to the PR description. Stop the Vite server afterwards. Fallback: if the dev server cannot start, record the exact error in the PR description and leave these steps to the test role's UAT.
